findings: The word/draw interpreter equalities preserve the complete literal binary Output, including the steps field. Induction follows actual predecessor fuel and both acceptance/rejection branches; the reasoning tree does not replace the executed sampler.

The tree maps each same draw to its actual record state update. execute_tree is a whole-monad equality for arbitrary lawful source effects, and same_stream retains the actual finite-list reader state as well as the full output/ledger.

The binary/Within proofs bound worst-case requests by decoded fuel times the proved width, including zero fuel. A fixed independent prefix of that length realizes the full Output times Ledger law, so the operations counter is retained; the law itself projects away the final reader suffix, which remains bound separately by same_stream and the prefix suffix theorem.

run_supported covers arbitrary finite lists, even exhausted lists whose reader defaults to zero. That deterministic zero is supported by the ideal binary draw, so support induction is valid without a list-length assumption. actual_charge therefore applies the same-record PMF support charge to the actual returned ledger, without resampling or independent-state assumptions.
validation: All three primary files exactly matched remote contents. Seven direct/operational dependencies matched frozen remote Git blob hashes. No compiler run; production CI was pending at review time.
scope: One concrete sampler callback and the declared instruction model only. Whole tape/query composition, fuel-construction charging, memory/layout costs and physical host runtime are not established by these files.
